低音的波長長，程式需要收集足夠長的時間才判得出來，慢半拍是正常的，等它穩定再讀數: Low notes have long wavelengths, so the program needs to collect enough of the sound before it can decide. A half-beat of lag is normal; wait for the number to settle before reading it.
